title: 第1718章说起来这李氏跟本王还有点关系第1717章为了大局让一让
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: 嗡！
郑玄龄眉头一皱。
殿内众人也全都愣住了。
他们没想到高阳会忽然问出这样一个问题。
郑玄龄沉吟片刻，缓缓道：“若两害相权，只能取其轻。”
“救百人而牺牲一人，虽残忍，却也是不得已。”
“因此老夫觉得，车夫该改道！”
高阳点了点头，并不觉得意外。
“那本王再问。”
“若旁边小路上站着的那个人，是郑公你呢？”
郑玄龄脸色骤变。
高阳却没有停，再次问道。
“或者，是郑公你的儿子呢。”
轰！
这句话落下。
偏殿内的气氛骤然一静。
郑玄龄的嘴唇动了动，一时竟说不出话。
孙博文也沉默了。
因为这个问题太扎心。
站在高处说大局，人人都能说得极为漂亮。
可真当那个被牺牲的人，忽然变成自己，变成自己的儿子，变成自己寒窗苦读十几年、终于凭本事赢了一次的亲人时。
这大局两个字，还能不能说得那么轻松那么大义凛然？
武曌看向高阳，一双凤眸闪烁，里面充斥着无穷的异彩。
高阳看着他们，语气平静的道。
“本王问诸公，许观澜有什么错？”
“他买题了吗？”
“他作弊了吗？”
“他托关系了吗？”
“他知道自己要压过李文轩吗？”
“他不知道。”
“他只是坐在贡院里，答了自己的卷子。”
“糊名之下，他不叫许观澜，他只是甲字二十三号。”
“李文轩也不叫李文轩，他只是乙字七号。”
“诸位方才看卷子的时候，谁知道他们会是谁？”
高阳的质问之下，无人说话。
高阳继续的道：“本王选他第一，是因为许观澜在灾政、佛门、六科取仕上，比李文轩的卷子更敢往前走，那李文轩太怂了。”
“两人在水平差不多之下，本王取的甲字二十三号为魁首！”
“诸位也认了。”
“陛下也准了。”
“现在拆名一看，发现许观澜是寒门，李文轩是江南李氏。”
content_en:
Buzz!
Zheng Xuanling frowned.
Everyone in the hall was also stunned.
They didn't expect Gao Yang to suddenly ask such a question.
Zheng Xuanling pondered for a moment and said slowly: "If there are two evils, we can only choose the lesser."
"Sacrificing one person to save a hundred people is cruel, but it is also a last resort."
"So I think the coachman should change the route!"
Gao Yang nodded, not surprised.
"Okay."
"Then I will ask again."
"What if the person standing on the path next to you is Mr. Zheng?"
Zheng Xuanling's expression suddenly changed.
Gao Yang didn't stop and asked again.
"Perhaps he is your son, Mr. Zheng."
Boom!
This sentence fell.
The atmosphere in the side hall suddenly became quiet.
Zheng Xuanling's lips moved and she was speechless for a moment.
Sun Bowen also fell silent.
Because this question is so heartbreaking.
Everyone can speak extremely beautifully when talking about the overall situation from a high position.
But when the person who was sacrificed suddenly turned into himself, his son, and his relative who had studied hard for more than ten years and finally won with his own ability.
Can the word "overall situation" be said so easily and so righteously?
Wu Zhao looked at Gao Yang, a pair of phoenix eyes twinkling, filled with endless splendor.
Gao Yang looked at them and said calmly.
"I would like to ask all the gentlemen, what is wrong with Xu Guanlan?"
"Did he buy the question?"
"Did he cheat?"
"Did he ask for help?"
"Does he know that he has to overpower Li Wenxuan?"
"He doesn't know."
"He just sat in the tribute courtyard and answered his own paper."
"Anonymous, his name is not Xu Guanlan, he is only No. 23."
"Li Wenxuan is not called Li Wenxuan, he is just number seven."
"When you read the papers just now, who knew who they would be?"
Under Gao Yang's questioning, no one spoke.
Gao Yang continued: "I chose him first because Xu Guanlan dared to move forward more than Li Wenxuan in terms of disaster management, Buddhism, and the six subjects. Then Li Wenxuan is too cowardly."
"The two of them are of about the same level, so I choose Number 23 as the leader!"
"You all agree."
"Your Majesty is also right."
"Now when I look at the names, I find that Xu Guanlan is from a poor family, and Li Wenxuan is from the Jiangnan Li family."
title_en: Chapter 1718 Speaking of which, the Li family has some relationship with me. Chapter 1717 Give way for the sake of the overall situation.
